TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with the Procession on the Occasion of Bhagwan Valmiki Jayanti 07.10.2025 (Tuesday) from 03:00 PM onwards

📍 Procession Route:
Red Fort → Gauri Shankar Mandir → Shish Ganj Gurudwara → Chandni Chowk → Town Hall → Nai Sarak → Barshabulla Chowk → Chawri Bazar → Hauz Qazi Chowk → Ajmeri Gate → Paharganj Bridge → Chuna Mandi → Ramakrishna Mission → Chitragupta Road → Concludes at Bhagwan Valmiki Mandir, Mandir Marg
📍Traffic likely to be affected:
Netaji Subhash Marg, Chawri Bazar Rd, Ajmeri Gate Rd, Desh Bandhu Gupta Rd, Ramakrishna Ashram Marg, Chitragupta Rd
📍Diversions (as required):
Subhash Park T-Point, Chhatta Rail Chowk, Hauz Qazi Chowk, Ajmeri Gate Chowk, R/A Jhandewalan, Paharganj Chowk
📍Avoid the above stretches from 03:00 PM onwards
📍Use public transport and park only in designated areas
📍Leave with sufficient time if travelling towards Red Fort, Hauz Qazi, or Jhandewalan
📍Report any suspicious object/person to Police at 112
📍Stay Updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels

#DPTrafficAdvisory

#3MB
#TrafficUpdate

Moving ahead to China Town and Alapere is better with another delay at Ogudu and Iyana Oworo due to bus stop activities, coupled with the influx of Vehicles coming from Gbagada.

Inward and outward of the Third mainland bridge is still an encouraging Vehicular flow.
#FollowLASTMA
